{{Resonator Tabs}} {{Language Tabs}} ==About Voicelines== {{VO |character = Danjin |language = en |vo_01_01_title = Thoughts: I |vo_01_01_file = {character}{language} Thoughts I.ogg |vo_01_01_tx = Greetings, Rover whom I've come across in my journey. What are you travelling for? You can't quite recall? Hmm, no worries. I'm sure you will rediscover it along the way. |vo_01_02_title = Thoughts: II |vo_01_02_intimacy = 1 |vo_01_02_file = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg |vo_01_02_tx = I was scared, too, when I first started travelling alone. Especially at night, I had this constant feeling of being followed. That's when I'd start chanting to myself, 'Keep going, don't look back'. Master always said that if I kept pushing forward, I'd eventually reach the light of dawn. |vo_01_03_title = Thoughts: III |vo_01_03_intimacy = 2 |vo_01_03_file = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg |vo_01_03_tx = I've gotten used to walking in the dark, braving the ever-changing weather and rugged roads in the wilderness. That doesn't mean I'm letting my guard down. I'll always keep an eye on the shadows—I won't let them hurt anyone in my reach ever again. |vo_01_04_title = Thoughts: IV |vo_01_04_intimacy = 3 |vo_01_04_file = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg |vo_01_04_tx = The path of vengeance that I seek is destined to be filled with darkness and peril, like trudging alone through an endless night. Fortunately, with you around, I won't lose myself so easily. |vo_01_05_title = Thoughts: V |vo_01_05_intimacy = 4 |vo_01_05_file = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg |vo_01_05_tx = With you by my side, I can fight without worry... Even if the crimson haze momentarily clouds my sight, you'll be there to help me break free from it, right? |vo_02_01_title = Danjin's Hobby |vo_02_01_file = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg |vo_02_01_tx = I enjoy releasing lanterns into the sky, watching as the solitary lantern in my hand joins the beautiful sea of many lights, setting them free one by one. That sight always fills me with a nostalgic warmth. |vo_02_02_title = Danjin's Trouble |vo_02_02_file = {character}{language} Trouble.ogg |vo_02_02_tx = Sometimes I get a little carried away in battles... I didn't startle you, did I? |vo_02_03_title = Favorite Food |vo_02_03_file = {character}{language} Favorite Food.ogg |vo_02_03_tx = Will there ever be {{Extra Effect|Loong Whiskers Crisps|Loong Whiskers Crisp|Danjin's favorite dessert. It is considered a symbol of good luck and blessings because of its association with loong.}} that are as loooong as a real loong's whiskers? Aww, I really want to give them a try! |vo_02_04_title = Disliked Food |vo_02_04_file = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg |vo_02_04_tx = Star Flakes are pretty, but they're a pain to keep fresh. I once packed a pouchful of them to enjoy while I was out in the wild, and they quickly turned soggy and lost their crunch. |vo_02_05_title = Ideals |vo_02_05_file = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg |vo_02_05_tx = Wherever I go, I swear to vanquish evil, whether it's out in the daylight or hiding in the dark. |vo_03_01_title = Chat: I |vo_03_01_file = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg |vo_03_01_tx = No matter what happens, no matter what I've been through, this jade pendant will forever stay clear and bright. |vo_03_02_title = Chat: II |vo_03_02_file = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg |vo_03_02_tx = It's easy to cut down my enemies with a sword swing, but eradicating evil is not as simple. One oversight and it silently regenerates, ready to make a comeback... That's why I must uproot and shatter every trace of evil I see. |vo_04_01_title = About [[Mortefi]] |vo_04_01_intimacy = 1 |vo_04_01_file = {character}{language} About Mortefi.ogg |vo_04_01_tx = Mortefi may seem a bit intimidating, but he's actually quite nice. Once my blade got really worn out, and Mortefi repaired it for me. To repay his kindness, that week I wiped out several groups of bandits eyeing the Tacetite weapons he developed... He ended up having to repair it for me again. |vo_04_01_mention = Mortefi |vo_04_02_title = About [[Chixia]] |vo_04_02_intimacy = 2 |vo_04_02_file = {character}{language} About Chixia.ogg |vo_04_02_tx = You can never go wrong by taking lost children to Chixia. While some kids may find me scary, they would never be scared of her. |vo_04_02_mention = Chixia |vo_04_03_title = About [[Yinlin]] |vo_04_03_intimacy = 3 |vo_04_03_file = {character}{language} About Yinlin.ogg |vo_04_03_tx = The familiar sight of Yinlin's thunder always reassures me that the upcoming battle will be a breeze.
Though, I must admit, it took me until at least our tenth collaboration to finally learn her name... Embarrassingly so. |vo_04_03_mention = Yinlin |vo_04_04_title = About [[Yangyang]] |vo_04_04_intimacy = 4 |vo_04_04_file = {character}{language} About Yangyang.ogg |vo_04_04_tx = When I just met Yangyang, I had been curious how someone could always be such a sweetheart. Later, I finally learned how gentleness with boundary has a powerful strength of its own. |vo_04_04_mention = Yangyang |vo_04_05_title = About [[Rover]] |vo_04_05_intimacy = 5 |vo_04_05_file = {character}{language} About Rover.ogg |vo_04_05_tx = You always act first in the face of injustice, despite having lost all memories... You must always have been a righteous person, right? I'd be very troubled if it turned out otherwise. |vo_04_05_mention = Rover |vo_05_01_title = Birthday Wishes |vo_05_01_file = {character}{language} Birthday Wishes.ogg |vo_05_01_tx = Happy Birthday, Rover! I made these {{Extra Effect|Loong Whiskers Crisps}} to be as long as those of our great Sentinel. They say eating something long on your birthday makes you live long and prosper. Enjoy! |vo_06_01_title = Idle: I |vo_06_01_file = {character}{language} Idle I.ogg |vo_06_01_tx = May the moonlight attest my steadfast will. |vo_06_02_title = Idle: II |vo_06_02_file = {character}{language} Idle II.ogg |vo_06_02_tx = *Effort Sound* |vo_06_03_title = Idle: III |vo_06_03_file = {character}{language} Idle III.ogg |vo_06_03_tx = *Effort Sound* |vo_07_01_title = Self-Introduction |vo_07_01_file = {character}{language} Self-Introduction.ogg |vo_07_01_tx = Greetings, my name is Danjin. I'm currently patrolling the lands as a ranger. Tell me about any injustice you've encountered, and I'll get it dealt with. You can't think of any? That's good. |vo_07_02_title = Greeting |vo_07_02_file = {character}{language} Greeting.ogg |vo_07_02_tx = Ranger, Danjin. Worry not, my Crimson Blade will not harm you as long as you haven't done anything bad. |vo_08_01_title = Join Team: I |vo_08_01_file = {character}{language} Join Team I.ogg |vo_08_01_tx = Hopefully my patience will pay off this time. |vo_08_02_title = Join Team: II |vo_08_02_file = {character}{language} Join Team II.ogg |vo_08_02_tx = Where to? I can lead the way for you. |vo_08_03_title = Join Team: III |vo_08_03_file = {character}{language} Join Team III.ogg |vo_08_03_tx = We should get going. |vo_09_01_title = Ascension: I |vo_09_01_ascension = 1 |vo_09_01_file = {character}{language} Ascension I.ogg |vo_09_01_tx = Now that my blade is faster, I should be able to make cleaner cuts. |vo_09_02_title = Ascension: II |vo_09_02_ascension = 2 |vo_09_02_file = {character}{language} Ascension II.ogg |vo_09_02_tx = My Crimson Blades are lasting longer, and my whole body feels so light... I never knew this sword could feel so light in my hands. |vo_09_03_title = Ascension: III |vo_09_03_ascension = 3 |vo_09_03_file = {character}{language} Ascension III.ogg |vo_09_03_tx = Vengeance is not mindless killing. It is about identifying the root of malice, and hitting where it truly hurts. Thank you, the move you've taught me has been very useful. |vo_09_04_title = Ascension: IV |vo_09_04_ascension = 4 |vo_09_04_file = {character}{language} Ascension IV.ogg |vo_09_04_tx = For many years, a crimson rage of vengence had been consuming me, devouring me from within. Now... I can feel it fading away, gradually drown out by the warmth of your kindness.
With you by my side, I won't have to journey alone... not anymore. |vo_09_05_title = Ascension: V |vo_09_05_ascension = 5 |vo_09_05_file = {character}{language} Ascension V.ogg |vo_09_05_tx = My eyes have been opened... I'm starting to realize how there's so much more to the world than just fighting for justice. There are countless amazing things waiting to be discovered, and the best part is having you by my side. }} ==Combat== {{Combat VO |character = Danjin |language = en |resskill_1_tx = Upswing! |resskill_2_tx = Strike! |resskill_3_tx = Repose! |resskill_4_tx = Harmonize! |resskill_5_tx = Vanquish! |resskill_6_tx = Oblivion! |resliberation_1_tx = Judgement! |resliberation_2_tx = Eradicate! |resliberation_3_tx = No mercy! |hit_1_tx = *Effort Sound* |hit_2_tx = *startled sound*.
